cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(sh3_qtbase_fixture LANGUAGES CXX)
enable_testing()

# A missing explicit input must never fall back to another installed Qt.
if(NOT IS_DIRECTORY "${SH3_QT_CMAKE_ROOT}/Qt6")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Set SH3_QT_CMAKE_ROOT to the explicit Qt lib/cmake directory")
endif()
foreach(component Core CoreTools Gui GuiTools Widgets WidgetsTools Test)
  if(NOT EXISTS "${SH3_QT_CMAKE_ROOT}/Qt6${component}/Qt6${component}Config.cmake")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing explicit Qt component: ${component}")
  endif()
  set(Qt6${component}_DIR "${SH3_QT_CMAKE_ROOT}/Qt6${component}")
endforeach()
find_package(Qt6 6.11.1 EXACT CONFIG REQUIRED COMPONENTS Core Gui Widgets Test
  PATHS "${SH3_QT_CMAKE_ROOT}/Qt6" NO_DEFAULT_PATH)

set(CMAKE_AUTOMOC ON)
set(CMAKE_AUTORCC ON)
set(CMAKE_AUTOUIC ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

add_executable(qb_core core.cpp emitter.hpp fixture.hpp resources.qrc)
target_link_libraries(qb_core PRIVATE Qt6::Core)
add_executable(qb_images images.cpp fixture.hpp)
target_link_libraries(qb_images PRIVATE Qt6::Gui)
add_executable(qb_widgets widgets.cpp fixture.hpp panel.ui)
target_link_libraries(qb_widgets PRIVATE Qt6::Widgets)
foreach(target qb_core qb_images qb_widgets)
  target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
endforeach()
foreach(case signals json resources)
  add_test(NAME qb_${case} COMMAND qb_core ${case})
endforeach()
foreach(case png jpeg)
  add_test(NAME qb_${case} COMMAND qb_images ${case})
endforeach()
add_test(NAME qb_widgets COMMAND qb_widgets)
set_tests_properties(qb_signals qb_json qb_resources qb_png qb_jpeg qb_widgets
  PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 15)
set_tests_properties(qb_png qb_jpeg qb_widgets PROPERTIES
  ENVIRONMENT "QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen")

if(SH3_QT_PROVIDER_SOURCE)
  foreach(component CorePrivate TestPrivate)
    if(NOT EXISTS "${SH3_QT_CMAKE_ROOT}/Qt6${component}/Qt6${component}Config.cmake")
      message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing explicit private Qt component: ${component}")
    endif()
    set(Qt6${component}_DIR "${SH3_QT_CMAKE_ROOT}/Qt6${component}")
  endforeach()
  find_package(Qt6TestPrivate 6.11.1 EXACT CONFIG REQUIRED
    PATHS "${SH3_QT_CMAKE_ROOT}/Qt6TestPrivate" NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
  # Original tests are compiled unchanged against the same exported libraries.
  foreach(case qversionnumber qscopeguard)
    if(NOT EXISTS "${SH3_QT_PROVIDER_SOURCE}/tests/auto/corelib/tools/${case}/tst_${case}.cpp")
      message(FATAL_ERROR "Missing original test: ${case}")
    endif()
    add_executable(provider_${case}
      "${SH3_QT_PROVIDER_SOURCE}/tests/auto/corelib/tools/${case}/tst_${case}.cpp")
    target_link_libraries(provider_${case} PRIVATE Qt6::Core Qt6::Test)
    target_compile_options(provider_${case} PRIVATE -UNDEBUG)
    add_test(NAME provider_${case} COMMAND provider_${case})
    set_tests_properties(provider_${case} PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 60)
  endforeach()
  target_link_libraries(provider_qversionnumber PRIVATE Qt6::TestPrivate)
endif()
